events.title: 🛸NEW ALIEN BIOME
events.subtitle: THE NEWEST BIOME IS HERE!
events.description:
Paranoid Pete tried to warn us, but nobody believed him. Now, his radar is picking up stronger signals of extraterrestrial activity, and strange UFO sightings are becoming more frequent.

It looks like the aliens have set their sights on Steal an Egg, and they're getting closer.

🛸 A NEW ALIEN BIOME ARRIVES NEXT WEEK!

events.title: Black Market Dealer!
events.subtitle: 🕵️ SLICK RICK IS COMING
events.description:
🕵️ SLICK RICK IS COMING TO TOWN! 💼

A mysterious Black Market Dealer is making his way into Steal an Egg.

💼 Meet Slick Rick! Nobody knows where he came from, what he's selling, or what he's really up to...

⏳ But there's a catch... Slick Rick comes and goes whenever he pleases. You never know when he'll show up, or how long he'll stick around.

👀 Keep your eyes peeled... Slick Rick is arriving soon!
